# Toledo equation codes

**Auto-generated by `tools/toledo_codes.py` -- do not hand-edit.** Regenerate after any re-copy of `docs/toledo/idm_roots.json` / `docs/toledo/idm_readings.json` from Toledo's own merge output.

Toledo ([https://github.com/morrocwi/toledo](https://github.com/morrocwi/toledo), concept DOI [10.5281/zenodo.22537318](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22537318)) is the permanent, public, coded equation library that is this project's equation source of record (founder rulings BBL-205/209, BBL-2026-09-08). Every equation, theorem, and definition below was registered into Toledo under the root-extension mechanism documented in Toledo's own `registry/GENESIS_CODE_SCHEME.md` ("Root registry extension R2, 2026-09-08, information-discrete-math") -- 18 Layer-0 roots (this repo's own identifiers, never re-prefixed or renumbered) and 274 Layer-1 readings, one per Coq identifier in the 274/274-closed `coq/information-discrete-math/verify_report.json` mirror Toledo carries.

Totals: **18 roots**, **274 readings** across **27 Coq source files**.

Tiers are copied from what this repo's own treatise/`THEOREM.md`/`SKILL.md` and Toledo's `verify_report.json` state -- never raised. In particular the `R` (`ℝ`) root is tiered Toledo tiers the `R` rung "Th_coqc, axiom-free unless noted" (verbatim); this repo adds its own caveat that any file importing `Coq.Reals` is not claimed axiom-free.
